ody.text: In Odyssey, Jeska is the sister of Kamahl, who leaves the Pardic Mountains and her to make a name for himself, drawn by the Mirari.

When the Mirari drives him berserk and he wounds her horribly with his enhanced sword, Braids captures the dying Jeska and brings her to the Cabal Patriarch, whose attempt to destroy her gives birth to Phage the Untouchable.
Phage builds the Grand Coliseum, and there she and Akroma fight Kamahl, who wins after Akroma loses her legs.

Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage and leaves her Jeska again, but to save the land she pulls them back into herself, damning herself to life as Phage, until Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Phage and Akroma, and accidentally Zagorka, and their essences form Karona.

jud.text: In Judgment, Jeska says that she and Kamahl both come from Balthor's forge, and with Balthor she tries to separate the Mirari from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence.

Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl unites the tribes by excessive power and plunges them into civil war, and when Jeska and Balthor decide to steal the Mirari he impales her with the Mirari-sword, leaving an incurable wound.
Braids later kidnaps her and the Cabal Patriarch turns her into Phage, until Karona is betrayed and killed by her minions Sash and Waistcoat, which releases Jeska and she becomes a planeswalker.

ons.text: In Onslaught, Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death, after Braids takes her from Seton's hut and kills Seton.
Phage kills Nivea in the pits, which leaves Ixidor ruined and swearing revenge, and Ixidor creates Akroma to destroy her.
Kamahl fights Phage, but his sister does not recognize him, and the Nightmare War follows as Phage's victims become deathwurms.
Jeska resurfaces for a time and, with Akroma and Kamahl's aid, decides to absorb the nightmares back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again, and she then despises Kamahl.

lgn.text: In Legions, Phage sways the Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns that Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
The First plots to murder Phage without knowing she is pregnant with his child, and Phage and Akroma battle until Stonebrow injures them both and Phage flees to give birth.
Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and she and Braids take control of the Cabal after Braids summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch.
When Kamahl arrives with the Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower onto Phage and Akroma, the Soul Reaper kills them all and the goddess Karona is born.

scg.text: In Scourge, Akroma marches on the Sanctum and fights Phage atop the dome, while the Krosans led by Stonebrow and Kamahl smash their way in against Phage's reanimated Cabal army.
Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona, and Kamahl then frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.
Karn returns to Otaria, tells Jeska she is a planeswalker and asks her to travel the multiverse with him.

tsp.text: In Time Spiral, Jeska appears on Dominaria during the temporal crisis searching for Karn, but she falls under the mental control of Leshrac, who hopes to use her Phage powers against Bolas.
Under his influence she defeats Radha in Keld, closes the Zhalfir rift without consulting Teferi, and at Yavimaya immolates Multani's physical form before closing that rift too.
On Madara Leshrac strips her Phage legacy and encases her in stone when she refuses to fight Bolas, who frees her and tells her the Otarian rift cannot be closed.
Jeska shatters the image of Karona and closes all rifts in one discharge, which begins the Great Mending, and she dies and is welcomed in a white void by her dead brother Kamahl.

tsb.text: In Time Spiral Timeshifted, Jeska appears on the set's cards as a warrior adept.

fut.text: In Future Sight, Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn as Leshrac returns.
She seals the time rift before Zhalfir can be phased back in, effectively erasing it from Dominaria.
